rules.name: Check finite-verb agreement using local morphology
rules.guidance: When optional spaCy parsing supplies one unambiguous nominal subject and a finite verb with conflicting number morphology, offer a conservative inflection candidate for human review.
apply_when: A local parser identifies exactly one non-pronominal subject with explicit grammatical number.
The finite verb form is a supported present-tense or be-past form.
do_not_apply_when: The subject is pronominal, coordinated, ambiguous, or lacks explicit number morphology.
The verb form is unsupported or parser confidence is insufficient.
The edit changes tense, modality, negation, or a protected technical expression.
preservation: Never generate text or apply this proposal automatically.
Keep tense, aspect, negation, modality, citations, quantities, and technical terms unchanged.
Require human review before accepting the proposal.
